description: Before the start of the game, attach this unit to a friendly Faction Leader for the rest of the game. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it. The attached model is part of its Leader's battlegroup.

name: Arcane Assist
description: If its Leader is within 5" of this model during your Control Phase, the Leader can upkeep one spell without spending a focus or fury point.

name: Repair [d6] (★Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

name: Ancillary Attack (★ Action)
description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by an Ancillary Attack special action only once per turn.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Exhaust Fumes
description: When this model advances during its Normal Movement, for one round other friendly models gain concealment while within 3" of this model.

name: Turn Up The Heat
description: This model can use Turn Up the Heat at the start of its activation. This activation, this model gains +2 SPD. At the end of the activation, this model suffers d3 damage points.

name: Reposition [3"]
description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.

name: Volume Fire
description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

name: Blood Reaper
description: When this model makes an initial attack with this weapon, it makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon’s melee range. Blood Reaper attacks are simultaneous.

name: Knockdown
description: When a model is hit by an attack with this weapon, it becomes knocked down.

name: Trash
description: Gain an additional die on damage rolls with this weapon against knocked down targets.

name: Grinding Wheel
description: This weapon gains an additional die on attack rolls against small- and medium-based models.

name: True Mercenary
description: This model will work for any army. You may only include one model with True Mercenary in your list during list construction.

name: Revive
description: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model’s unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

name: Vision
description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

name: Dark Seduction
description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

name: Sucker!
description: If this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

name: Anatomical Precision
description: When this model’s melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Limited Battlegroup [Aberration]
description: The only cohort that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Aberration.

name: Vitalizer (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.

name: Journeyman Cephalyx Warcaster
description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Healing, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model may allocate focus point to monstrosities in it's battlegroup as if they were a warjack. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

name: Combat Drugs (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target Cohort in this model’s battlegroup gains Aggressive for one turn. (A model with Aggressive can run or charge without spending a focus point or being forced.)

name: Inflict Pain
description: When it hits a warbeast with this weapon, this model can place 1 fury point on or remove 1 fury point from the warbeast.

name: Brain Damage
description: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.

name: Companion [Exulon Nostilla]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Exulon Nostilla. If Nostilla is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Nostilla’s battlegroup.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Hormone Manipulation
description: When this model begins its activation in Nostilla's control range, choose one of the following effects. Hormone Manipulation effects last for one round.

name: •Adrenal Surge
description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, models with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: •Endorphin Dump
description: This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.

name: •Dopamine Boost
description: This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Impervious Flesh
description: When this model suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.

name: Critical Decapitation
description: On a critical hit, double the damage exceeding the ARM of the model hit. A model disabled by this attack cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Shadow Bind
description: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Reload [1]
description: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

name: Man Catcher
description: A warrior model hit by this attack suffers –2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model’s melee range for one round.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Primal
description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 MAT and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round and automatically frenzies during your next Control Phase. The target warbeast frenzies even if Primal was removed by a spell, special rule, or casting of a new animus on it prior to your next Control Phase.

name: Adrenalize
description: This model can use Adrenalize at any time during its activation. This model gains Berserk and Overtake that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Repairable
description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

name: Sturm & Drang
featDescription: While in Strum & Drang’s control range enemy Cohort models cannot gain, be allocated, or spend focus or essence points, or be forced. While in Sturm & Drang’s control range, enemy models cannot be used to channel spells. Psychic Apocalypse lasts for one round.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods.

name: Polarity Shield
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Polarity Field. (A model with Polarity Field cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.)

name: Telekinesis
description: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.

name: Vision
description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

name: Deflection
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks. Deflection lasts for one round.

name: Mental Domination [Shield Guard]
description: While in this model’s control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Struggle of Wills
description: Before the start of the game and at the start of each of your Maintenance Phases after your first turn, choose which mind is dominant: Sturm or Drang. Use that mind’s stats and rules for one round.

name: Drang
featDescription: While in Strum & Drang’s control range enemy Cohort models cannot gain, be allocated, or spend focus or essence points, or be forced. While in Sturm & Drang’s control range, enemy models cannot be used to channel spells. Psychic Apocalypse lasts for one round.

name: Killing Ground
description: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain Pathfinder. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can charge or make slam power attacks against enemy models without being forced. Killing Ground lasts for one turn.

name: Obliteration
description: On a critical hit, models hit are knocked down.

name: Mental Domination [Overtake]
description: While in this model’s control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Ferocity
description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD when making a charge.

name: Shortsighted
description: This model cannot upkeep spells.

name: Struggle of Wills
description: Before the start of the game and at the start of each of your Maintenance Phases after your first turn, choose which mind is dominant: Sturm or Drang. Use that mind’s stats and rules for one round.

name: Berserk
description: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.

name: Critical Pitch
description: On a critical hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit can be thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods.

description: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.

name: Spell Ward
description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

name: Unyielding
description: This model gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.

name: Vampiric
description: When this model destroys a living or undead model with a melee or ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Mercenary [Unlimited - Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods]
description: In games played in the Unlimited Arena this model will work for Circle, Legion, Skorne, and Trollbloods.

name: Dig In (★Action)
description: This model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged. It can begin the game dug in.

name: Casting a Spell with Focus or Fury
Lightning Strike
description: The spellcaster gains Sprint. Lightning Strike lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Full Boar
description: This model can use Full Boar at the start of its activation. This model gains +2 SPD that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Full Boar can be used only once per activation.

name: Repairable
description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

name: Critical Knockdown
description: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Blessing of the Gods
description: Play this card any time during your activation on one of your models. That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.

name: Break Through
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Unstoppable this activation.

name: Careful Reconnaissance
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Pathfinder this activation.

name: Defenses
description: Play this card at the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Barrier
description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Fire Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

name: Exploding!
description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Targetable
description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

name: Demolition
description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

name: Spike Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Duck and Cover!

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Lucky Penny
description: Play this card at the start of a friendly model’s activation to give that model one corpse token, essence point, focus point, fury point, rage token, or soul token.

name: Old Faithful
description: Play this card during your Control Phase before allocating focus. Remove d3+1 damage from a friendly Cohort model or battle engine in your army.

name: Put the Fires Out
description: Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your model/units. If the affected models were knocked down, they stand up. If the affected models were stationary, the stationary status expires. If the affected models were suffering continuous or shakable effects, like Blind or Shadow Bind, those effects expire.

name: Sapper
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Immediately remove a Defense from the table.
